slots.notes: Fullscreen autoplaying muted looping background video, absolutely positioned inset-0 object-cover behind all foreground content.
Monochrome inline SVG brand mark (18x18, viewBox 0 0 256 256) sitting in the circular nav pill; single path filled with a solid mid-gray that should follow the fg color role.

mechanic: Static bottom-left hero copy stack layered over a fullscreen looping background video, with hover micro-interactions that fill the CTA blue and nudge inline arrows right.
techDelivery: Vite single-page React + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS (all markup in src/App.tsx; deps limited to react, react-dom, lucide-react).
reskinNotes: Logo is a hand-built inline SVG path with the mid-gray fill (rgb(84,84,84)) hardcoded in markup; pill backgrounds (#EDEDED) and page bg (#f0f0ee) are set via inline style and a Tailwind arbitrary value rather than tokens; accent blues and grays are Tailwind utility classes (blue-400/500/600, gray-400/700/900) baked into className strings; all copy (nav labels, badge, headline, subtext, CTA) is hardcoded in JSX; type scale is fixed pixel/rem arbitrary values, so a swapped display font may need metric re-tuning.
